card.name: Space before storage-time durations
card.fires_on: The space right after "for", "for up to", "within" or "up to" when a number of hours or days comes next. It appears in stability and storage statements for diluted or reconstituted drug solutions.

modes.label: Stable for N hours
modes.description: Space after "for" or "for up to" in a stability statement, just before a number of hours.
modes.example: the final admixture is stable for<< >>24 hours stored under refrigerated conditions

modes.label: The limit of use within N days
modes.description: Space after "within" in a use-by instruction for a reconstituted solution.

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number saying how long a mixed or diluted drug stays usable.
